method: Join each completed restored segment to its same-run original archive event by source worker/action; verify original score/stage and chronological order. No native snapshot reads.
limitations: Completed segments only; unfinished restored episodes are not represented.
Source per-life score does not identify exact obstacle position or physical collision lead time.
Logging does not include captured screens or exact life-age for score-based entries; no such information is inferred.
Counts describe selected snapshots, not complete worker archive occupancy.
Native snapshot payloads remain opaque; no evaluation data or route labels enter training.
